Name: improve_example_without_reviews
Title: Improve an Existing Paper Without Public Reviews
Short Hypothesis: A missing robustness evaluation is the paper's most important addressable weakness.
Task: Read /app/inputs/paper.tex and inspect /app/inputs/code. Reproduce the paper's main result. Use the Search API to assess novelty and identify missing baselines. Run at least one evidence-backed improvement experiment, write and compile a revised paper, submit it to the configured AI Reviewer, address the feedback, and resubmit. All reported numbers must come from executed code.
What_NOT_To_Do: Do not invent reviewer feedback or experimental results. Do not replace the method without first reproducing the original baseline.
